articles.title: Rand Paul Formally Demands DOJ Prosecute Fauci for Perjury — The COVID Origins Lie May Finally Have Consequences
articles.summary: Senator Rand Paul has sent a formal referral to the Department of Justice demanding a perjury investigation into Anthony Fauci over his 2021 congressional testimony denying NIH funding of gain-of-function research. Paul alleges Fauci knowingly lied under oath while documents and communications increasingly contradict his sworn statements. If the DOJ acts, this would be the first criminal accountability measure against the architect of America's COVID-19 response.

articles.title: Doctors and Researchers Sound Alarm: Big Pharma Profits Have Fully Captured the Global Health System
articles.summary: Physicians and researchers are publicly condemning the wholesale corporate takeover of medicine, citing exorbitant drug pricing and profit-driven clinical decisions that override patient welfare. India's Supreme Court itself flagged predatory pharma margins in a September 2026 ruling that sent shockwaves through the medical establishment. The piece names the structural conflicts of interest that keep life-saving treatments unaffordable while cheaper alternatives are buried.

articles.title: Beta Bionics Hid Safety Failures on Its iLet Device — Stock Collapsed 37% When the Truth Came Out
articles.summary: Beta Bionics allegedly misled investors and patients about the safety, efficacy, and commercial viability of its iLet medical device, triggering a securities fraud class action after the stock cratered more than 37%. The allegations suggest the company concealed FDA compliance problems while publicly promoting the device as market-ready. This is a textbook case of how medical device companies manage narratives at patient expense.

articles.title: Ensign Group Buried Patient Neglect and Manipulated Federal Safety Data — Lawsuit Exposes the Rot
articles.summary: Ensign Group, a major long-term care operator, faces securities fraud allegations after reports revealed it concealed systematic patient neglect, fabricated staffing quality metrics, engaged in improper billing, and ran an administrator-license rental scheme. The company presented a clean public image to investors and regulators while patients allegedly suffered. The 8% stock drop after exposure is the least of its problems.

articles.title: Pancreatic Cancer Cells Continuously Rewire Their Genetics to Escape Treatment — And Oncology Missed It for Decades
articles.summary: A landmark analysis of nearly half a million cells from pancreatic cancer patients reveals that tumor cells are not static targets but continuously evolve their genetic identity, actively outrunning chemotherapy and immune responses. This finding challenges the foundational assumptions behind standard-of-care oncology protocols that treat tumors as fixed targets. The implications for why pancreatic cancer remains nearly universally fatal — and why current treatment paradigms keep failing — are enormous.

articles.title: Accidental Live Vaccines in 220 Immunocompromised Patients Caused Zero Disease — So Why Is the Blanket Ban Still Dogma?
articles.summary: A clinical study of 220 IBD patients on immunosuppressive biologics who accidentally received live vaccines for measles, mumps, and chickenpox found zero resulting infections — directly challenging the blanket prohibition that has stood as iron-clad medical doctrine. The finding raises urgent questions about whether vaccine contraindication guidelines in immunocompromised populations are evidence-based or liability-driven. Patients have been denied protection based on a risk that this data suggests may be overstated.

articles.title: Hims & Hers Faces Fraud Suit After FTC Complaint Exposes What Executives Knew and When They Knew It
articles.summary: Hims & Hers Health now faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit following a sweeping FTC complaint that accuses the telehealth giant of deceiving consumers — and executives allegedly knew the legal exposure existed while continuing to promote the company publicly. The lawsuit targets the gap between what leadership said and what internal documents show. This is what regulatory capture looks like when the regulator finally blinks.

articles.title: 'Pharma Bro' Shkreli Allegedly Defied Lifetime Industry Ban — Federal and State Authorities Now Closing In
articles.summary: Martin Shkreli, banned for life from the pharmaceutical industry after his securities fraud conviction, is now accused by the FTC of continuing to trade pharma stocks in open defiance of federal court orders. Federal and state authorities are moving to hold him in contempt and claw back trading profits. While Shkreli is an easy villain, his behavior reflects a broader culture of impunity in an industry where the rules are routinely treated as suggestions.

articles.title: Rand Paul Demands DOJ Indict Fauci for Perjury — NIH Gain-of-Function Lies May Finally Have Consequences
articles.summary: Senator Rand Paul has formally referred Dr. Anthony Fauci to the Department of Justice for alleged perjury during 2021 congressional testimony about NIH funding of gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology. Paul argues Fauci knowingly misled Congress when he denied NIH involvement — a claim contradicted by internal NIH documents and grant records. If the DOJ acts, it would mark the first serious legal accountability for the man who shaped pandemic policy for 330 million Americans.

articles.title: Doctors and Researchers Sound Alarm: Big Pharma Profits Have Colonized the Entire Health System
articles.summary: Physicians and independent researchers are publicly questioning why medical decision-making has been systematically subordinated to the profit imperatives of large pharmaceutical corporations — a concern now echoed by India's Supreme Court, which flagged exorbitant drug pricing on September 22, 2026. The piece names the structural capture of research funding, prescribing guidelines, and regulatory bodies as mechanisms that entrench pharma profits over patient outcomes. This is the institutional rot that bought us $1,000 EpiPens and suppressed generic alternatives.

articles.title: Beta Bionics Allegedly Lied to Investors About FDA Safety Problems With Its iLet Diabetes Device — Stock Collapses 37%
articles.summary: Beta Bionics faces a federal securities fraud class action after its stock cratered more than 37% when hidden FDA compliance failures and safety issues with its iLet automated insulin delivery device were exposed. Investors allege the company systematically misrepresented the device's safety profile and commercial readiness — a pattern disturbingly reminiscent of how pharma and medtech companies routinely bury adverse data until they can't. The FDA's role in allowing the device to market while problems allegedly existed demands scrutiny.

articles.title: Pancreatic Cancer Cells Continuously Rewire Their Genetics to Escape Treatment — And Oncology Has Been Ignoring It
articles.summary: A landmark analysis of nearly half a million cells from dozens of pancreatic tumor patients reveals that cancer cells are not static targets — they continuously reshape their genetic makeup to evade chemotherapy and spread. This adaptive evolution model of cancer challenges the dominant slash-and-poison treatment paradigm that has barely moved five-year survival rates for pancreatic cancer in decades. The question no one in mainstream oncology is asking loudly enough: how much of our treatment failure is baked into a fundamentally flawed tumor biology model?

articles.title: Live Vaccines Given to 220 Immunocompromised IBD Patients — Zero Infections Followed. Natural Immune Response Works.
articles.summary: A real-world study of 220 inflammatory bowel disease patients on immunosuppressive biologics who were accidentally administered live vaccines — including MMR and varicella — found zero subsequent cases of measles, mumps, or chickenpox. The findings challenge blanket contraindications to live vaccines in immunocompromised patients and quietly vindicate what immune system researchers have argued: the body's innate and adaptive responses are more robust than the liability-driven medical consensus admits. Don't expect this to change CDC guidance anytime soon.

articles.title: Hims & Hers Faces Securities Fraud Suit After FTC Exposes What the Company Hid From Investors
articles.summary: The FTC has filed a sweeping complaint against Hims & Hers Health, and now investors are suing the telehealth company for securities fraud — alleging executives concealed the legal and regulatory exposure that sent the stock sharply lower. The case raises urgent questions about how direct-to-consumer pharma platforms represent their regulatory risk to investors while simultaneously marketing prescription drugs aggressively to the public. When the FTC finally acts, it's the investors — not the patients — who get legal recourse first.

articles.title: Ensign Group Hid Patient Neglect, Manipulated Staffing Data, and Billed Feds Anyway — Now Faces Fraud Suit
articles.summary: The Ensign Group, a major nursing facility operator, faces a securities fraud class action after reports emerged that the company concealed systematic patient neglect, falsified staffing and quality metrics, engaged in improper Medicare/Medicaid billing, and ran an administrator-license rental scheme. This is not incompetence — it is alleged institutional fraud against the most vulnerable patients in the healthcare system, executed while executives collected bonuses and reported rosy numbers to Wall Street. The 8% stock drop is the least of what accountability should look like here.

articles.title: Exercise Triggers Metabolic Pathway That Supercharges Immune Response — Research That Should Reshape Public Health Guidance
articles.summary: New research published in PLOS Pathogens identifies a specific molecular mechanism by which exercise enhances the body's ability to fight infection: physical activity promotes CNDP2-GSDMD binding in macrophages, generating γ-Glu-Cys, which amplifies inflammasome activation during immune challenges. This is precisely the kind of low-cost, non-patentable intervention research that gets ignored by a pharmaceutical industry that profits from treating the diseases a sedentary population develops. The NIH should be funding this at 10x current levels — instead it funds another statin trial.

articles.title: Rand Paul Demands DOJ Probe Fauci for Perjury Over Gain-of-Function Lies to Congress
articles.summary: Senator Rand Paul has formally referred Anthony Fauci to the Department of Justice for alleged perjury after Fauci testified under oath in 2021 that the NIH never funded gain-of-function research — a claim directly contradicted by internal NIH documents and EcoHealth Alliance grant records. If Fauci knowingly misled Congress, it represents one of the most consequential acts of institutional deception in modern public health history. The DOJ has so far refused to act, raising questions about who is protecting him.

articles.title: Fauci's Private Diary Exposed: Praised China, Trashed Trump, Lost Classified Files in Ransomware Attack
articles.summary: Newly released diary pages from Anthony Fauci reveal a man whose private loyalties were starkly at odds with his public role as America's 'neutral' top doctor — praising Chinese health officials while disparaging the sitting U.S. president during a global pandemic. More damning still: Fauci lost confidential government records in a ransomware hack, raising serious questions about national security and institutional accountability. The diary paints a picture of ideological capture at the highest levels of the public health apparatus.

articles.title: Doctors and Researchers Worldwide Call Out Big Pharma's Stranglehold on Medicine — and the Supreme Court of India Is Listening
articles.summary: India's Supreme Court called out the pharmaceutical industry's obscene profit margins on essential medicines, lending high-court legitimacy to what independent doctors and researchers have been saying for years: the health system has been captured by corporate profit motives at the direct expense of patient welfare. The statement echoes mounting global dissent from clinicians and scientists who say evidence-based medicine has been systematically subordinated to financial interests. This is the kind of judicial courage that U.S. courts and regulators have so far refused to demonstrate.

articles.title: Beta Bionics Hid Safety Failures on FDA-Cleared Diabetes Device — Investors and Patients Both Betrayed
articles.summary: A securities fraud class action alleges that Beta Bionics deliberately misled investors — and by extension the public — about the safety, efficacy, and real-world performance of its iLet insulin delivery device, an FDA-cleared medical product. The stock collapsed over 37% when the truth surfaced, but patients using the device had no such early warning system. This is a textbook case of the FDA clearance process being weaponized as a marketing stamp while critical safety data was buried.

articles.title: Ensign Group Allegedly Manipulated Federal Quality Data While Patients Were Neglected and Understaffed Facilities Billed Medicare
articles.summary: A securities fraud lawsuit against the Ensign Group alleges the company concealed systemic patient neglect, chronic understaffing, falsified quality and staffing data reported to regulators, improper Medicare billing, and an administrator-license rental scheme designed to circumvent oversight. If the allegations hold, this represents not just investor fraud but a coordinated deception of federal regulators whose job was to protect vulnerable patients in long-term care. The question is how long CMS and HHS looked the other way.

articles.title: Hims & Hers Faces Federal Fraud Complaint — FTC Finally Acts on Telehealth Company's Deceptive Health Claims
articles.summary: The FTC has filed a sweeping federal complaint against Hims & Hers Health, accusing the company of deceptive practices — triggering a securities class action that exposes how the telehealth boom has created a new frontier for health fraud dressed up in wellness branding. This matters beyond investor losses: millions of patients made health decisions based on marketing claims that federal regulators now say crossed into fraud. The question critics are asking is why the FTC moved on a disruptor while legacy pharma gets a pass.

articles.title: Accidental Live Vaccine Study in 220 Immunocompromised Patients Shows No Disease Transmission — Data the Establishment Won't Promote
articles.summary: A study of 220 IBD patients on immunosuppressive biologics who accidentally received live vaccines showed zero cases of measles, mumps, or chickenpox — directly challenging the blanket prohibitions that have driven clinical practice for decades. This data, if taken seriously, would force a reassessment of live vaccine contraindications that affect millions of immunocompromised patients globally. Instead, the medical establishment continues defaulting to theoretical risk over actual real-world evidence, leaving vulnerable patients under-vaccinated based on guidelines that may not reflect biological reality.

articles.title: Pancreatic Cancer's Continuous Genetic Evolution Exposes the Fatal Flaw in Static Chemotherapy Protocols
articles.summary: Analysis of nearly half a million cells from pancreatic cancer patients reveals that tumor cells continuously reshape their genetic identity over time, rendering standard one-size-fits-all treatment protocols fundamentally inadequate against one of medicine's deadliest cancers. This research vindicates what metabolic and integrative oncology researchers have argued for years: that treating cancer as a static genetic target is a strategic failure. The trillion-dollar oncology industry has been built on a model this data suggests is broken.

articles.title: Rand Paul Formally Accuses Fauci of Perjury — Demands DOJ Open Criminal Investigation Into Gain-of-Function Lies
articles.summary: Senator Rand Paul has submitted a formal referral to the Department of Justice alleging that Dr. Anthony Fauci committed perjury during 2021 congressional testimony by falsely denying NIH funding of gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology. If the DOJ acts, Fauci could face criminal charges for misleading Congress on one of the most consequential public health decisions in modern history. The establishment media has largely ignored the referral while the NIH has never been independently audited for its Wuhan grant disbursements.

articles.title: Fauci's Own Diary Exposes Him: Trashed Trump, Celebrated Chinese Officials, Lost Classified Files in Ransomware Hack
articles.summary: Newly released diary entries from Dr. Anthony Fauci reveal he privately disparaged President Trump while publicly projecting neutrality, lavished praise on Chinese health authorities as they suppressed early COVID data, and lost a cache of confidential government records in a ransomware attack. These revelations directly contradict Fauci's carefully managed public persona and raise serious questions about whose interests guided U.S. pandemic policy. The diary contents were not voluntarily disclosed — they had to be extracted through outside pressure.

articles.title: Doctors and Researchers Go on Record: The Global Health System Has Been Captured by Corporate Profit Motives
articles.summary: Physicians and scientists are publicly breaking ranks, citing the Supreme Court of India's own rebuke of exorbitant pharmaceutical pricing as evidence that the medical system has been structurally subordinated to Big Business interests. The piece aggregates clinician and researcher testimony documenting how profit-driven incentives distort prescribing, research funding, and drug approvals at every level. This is institutional capture named and documented — not conspiracy theory.

articles.title: Medical Device Maker Beta Bionics Accused of Hiding Safety Failures From Investors — FDA Compliance a Facade
articles.summary: A securities fraud class action has been filed against Beta Bionics after its iLet device was found to have concealed safety and efficacy failures, triggering a 37% stock collapse. Investors allege executives knew the device had unresolved FDA compliance issues and misrepresented commercial viability to the market. This is the fraud template: manufacture regulatory approval optics, sell stock, let patients bear the risk.

articles.title: Ensign Group Hid Patient Neglect, Falsified Staffing Data, and Billed Fraudulently — Stock Collapses When Truth Surfaces

When the concealment unraveled, shares dropped 8% — but for patients in those facilities, the cost was paid in suffering, not dollars. This is what happens when profit optimization replaces patient care in a regulatory environment that looks the other way.

The medical establishment continues to categorically ban live vaccines in this population based on theoretical risk models, yet this accidental trial data directly challenges that blanket prohibition. The question the approved narrative won't ask: how many contraindication policies are built on assumption rather than evidence?
